unbound.rules:
add table inet aegis_device_guard
flush table inet aegis_device_guard
add chain inet aegis_device_guard incoming { type filter hook prerouting priority -190; policy accept; }
add chain inet aegis_device_guard output { type filter hook output priority 10; policy drop; }
add chain inet aegis_device_guard forward { type filter hook forward priority 10; policy drop; }
add rule inet aegis_device_guard output oifname "lo" counter accept
add rule inet aegis_device_guard output oifname "aegis-tun0" counter accept
add rule inet aegis_device_guard incoming iifname "enp1s0" fib daddr type local tcp dport 22 ct direction original ct state { new, established } ct mark set 0xa3610002
add rule inet aegis_device_guard output oifname "enp1s0" meta l4proto tcp ct direction reply ct mark 0xa3610002 ct original proto-dst 22 tcp sport 22 counter accept
add rule inet aegis_device_guard incoming iifname "enp1s0" fib daddr type local tcp dport 443 ct direction original ct state { new, established } ct mark set 0xa3610002
add rule inet aegis_device_guard output oifname "enp1s0" meta l4proto tcp ct direction reply ct mark 0xa3610002 ct original proto-dst 443 tcp sport 443 counter accept
add rule inet aegis_device_guard output oifname "enp1s0" ip6 hoplimit 255 ip6 daddr { fe80::/10, ff02::/16 } icmpv6 type { nd-router-solicit, nd-neighbor-solicit, nd-neighbor-advert } counter accept
add rule inet aegis_device_guard output counter drop
add rule inet aegis_device_guard forward counter drop
